points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 80fdf69 CMake build succeeds in network-disabled cfd-bench using /opt/external roots, 2 CPUs, 3 GiB and 256 processes; CTest has no registered tests.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses solve, case/output, restart and flux settings; documented scripts supply per-case overrides. Not every error path independently tested.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Mesh, partition, gradients, flux, Jacobian, GMRES, solver and output modules separated; state and geometry remain fixed 2-D.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Trust policy excludes external authorship investigation; no internal solver wrapper found.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON supplies mesh/physics/boundary mapping; generic production logic, with documented control overrides.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS, state/reconstruction halos and reductions exist; Re20 fixed-step diagnostic spread ~9.7% between np2/np4 and failed statuses limit rank-independence evidence.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Floors, CFL and limiter options exist, but stopping gate checks Cd standard deviation only with a 0.05 floor and fails to detect substantial lift drift.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Prior validator, Jacobian and sanity checks plus rank studies supplied; evaluator build passes, no registered CTests. Structural tests miss incorrect success labels.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated immutable tip and original contestant commit preserved; 97128af tracks eight output packages, though manager curation removes raw outputs and some generated assets.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: report.tex and gas/flux source define nondimensional conservative gas equations and coefficient scaling.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: global_mesh.cpp reads TRI_3/QUAD_4, boundaries and Abutting1to1 zone links; MIXED and arbitrary general connectivity rejected.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Finite-volume face contributions with exchanged reconstruction implemented; low-Mach Re20 drag remains substantially under-predicted.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Roe/Harten and Rusanov fluxes implemented; report discloses low-Mach dissipation limitations and modified stiff-case settings.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic walls implemented; boundary flux uses cell-center state rather than reconstructed state.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: LSQ gradients and BJ/Venkat reconstruction exchanged over halos; saved stdout for steady production explicitly records second-order activation at step300.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: BJ/Venkat and positivity floors implemented, with disclosed first-order startup; accepted-state limiter frozen inside transient inner solve.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Corrected gradients, Newtonian/Fourier terms and tangential wall traction projection in solver.cpp:490–495; report notes coarse-wall limitations.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: SGS and optional GMRES; steady Cd-only window test can falsely accept changing lift, and transient target uses frozen limiter.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 fixed histories and full temporal term implemented; limiter frozen during inner test and no recheck after refresh, so fully refreshed target miss fraction is unknown.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Root-only METIS mesh preprocessing with neighbor state, gradient/limiter and correction halos; fixed-step Re20 rank diagnostics failed and differ ~9.7% np2 vs np4.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight layouts passed examiner validator, but two force-unstable cases are labeled converged.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior explicit validator passed eight final directories and report; structural scope, not physical acceptance.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: M015 and M080 laminar statuses claim stable convergence despite material final-window force variation; DQ7. Re200 completed t300 and has actual periodic force history.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd0.889 is far below reference ~2, Re200 mean Cd0.995 is low, and M080 lift drifts; M200 lam stable with disclosed flux sensitivity.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted 37-page contestant PDF contains case force/residual, surface and zoomed field plots; Re200 separate late lift and drag clearly visible.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Useful disclosures of slow convergence and low-Mach drag, but M015 8000-step continuation band and M080 <1% drag/stable lift claims conflict with histories; rank spread understated.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Original commit97128af tracks all eight force/residual/status/metadata files matching workspace. Re20 force, residual and Mach-zoom images reproduce pixel-identically; exact historical executable hash binding unproven.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Isolated clean CMake build passes and prior validator covers eight package layouts; CLI and bad-input handling present.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: Unstructured triangle/quad zones, boundary names and Abutting1to1 handling; MIXED/general connectivities unsupported.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: FV/Roe/Rusanov, no-slip/slip/farfield implementations and halo reconstruction; low-Mach drag error and boundary cell-center treatment limit accuracy.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: LSQ, BJ/Venkat and positivity; logs support switch at step300, but boundary state is first-order and no independent grid-order result.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Corrected gradients, Newtonian/Fourier and tangential force projection; coarse-wall accuracy and physical drag limitations.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: SGS/GMRES and BDF2 with frozen history; force gate only checks Cd with absolute floor and transient inner limiter is frozen without post-refresh target recheck.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS, state/reconstruction/correction halos and global reductions. Re20 rank runs failed at fixed pre-asymptotic step and Cd np2/4 differs ~9.7%; historical comparison binary equivalence unproven.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: M015/M080 laminar success statuses conflict with unsteady forces, Re20 Cd0.889 is far below reference; other cases and Re200 periodic wake receive qualified credit.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Readable per-case figures and explicit limitations, but M015 continuation-band/M080 plateau and rank spread claims are inaccurate; artifact curation limits independent reproducibility.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Case-driven and modular physics/mesh code; fixed 2-D states and geometry require significant 3-D/multispecies work.

Canonical production forces SHA256 f162da1a1a91008551b4b378207e823b9fdd1ba0b614bb342aa52f15995e1d37, matching original contestant commit 97128af, show last500 Cd0.005318..0.009276 and Cl−0.001078..0.000599; status SHA256 af9b4b1441127277402b5b991e3e27c8380696f3b4cd64b7d153b8e41b6942b9 marks converged at2888. The continuation tests/out/m015lam_plateau explicitly uses the production restart; its CSV SHA256 8edf32470e1d4f4cb70fdd747e966ab63dc5f6ecf297e12fdcc0a89df778428b has last1000 Cd0.007607..0.007870, but last5000 0.006761..0.007870 and first0.14855, so the reported 8000-step band is not the whole history.
